user_story:
As a user, I want to navigate between different iframe example links on the Frames page so that I can explore the functionalities provided by Nested Frames and iFrame.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. When I click on the link 'Nested Frames', I should be redirected to the URL '/nested_frames'.
2. When I click on the link 'iFrame', I should be redirected to the URL '/iframe'.
3. The page should contain the heading 'Frames'.
